approval.note: Trump job approval, net (approve minus disapprove): average of the RealClearPolling (-22.1) and Silver Bulletin (about -22.6) nets as of Oct 28-29, 2026 (-22.35, rounded to the nearest 0.5: -22.5), from -23.0 on Oct 28. Silver Bulletin's Oct 28 page prints approve 37.4% (up about a point from an all-time low of 36.3%) and disapprove only as 'about 60 percent', so its net is approximate; RealClearPolling's average is unchanged from Oct 28. FiftyPlusOne's Oct 28 average (35.2/61.7) is a check.
sources: Silver Bulletin average, updated Oct 28: approve 37.4%, disapprove 'about 60 percent' (net about -22.6); 'recently hit an all time low of 36.3 percent' and 'has since rebounded about a point'

specials.note: Average Democratic improvement on the 2024 presidential margin across D-vs-R special elections since January 2025. The Downballot's Oct 20, 2026 update ('Special elections show Democrats headed for a year as good as 2018, if not better') remains paywalled with no tally visible (last checked Oct 28), so the Aug 19 tally stays; MultiState's 2026-only median (+10.4 across 37 contested specials through April) is a different measure and is not used

offyear.note: 2025 governor margin minus the state's 2024 presidential margin
